title: workflow.requested
description: Multi-step work has been asked for. Published by the gateway; consumed by the orchestrator, which plans it into steps and drives them.

inputs.description: What the goal needs. A site_audit needs a start_url; seed is optional and derived from the site when absent.

track_keywords.description: How many researched keywords to rank-check. Each is a live search request.

optimize_pages.description: How many pages the rewrite plan covers.

competitors.description: Sites to compare against. Each becomes a crawl of somebody else's site, run every time this workflow runs, which is why the ceiling is lower than the competitor service's own eight.

competitor_pages.description: How deep to crawl each competitor. Smaller than your own crawl by default: the comparison reads rates and medians, which settle long before a whole site is fetched.
